changelog: Added Tri-Regional Climate System splitting San Andreas into 3 distinct macro-regions (South, Central, North) with independent weather and temperatures.
Smooth 200m buffer blending zone preventing sudden weather jumps when traveling between regions.
Overtime weather transitions via SetWeatherTypeOvertimePersist with gradual atmospheric fading.
Real-time continuous temperature blending with physiological thermodynamics and felt temperature support.
Comprehensive configuration in config.lua and developer exports for dynamic runtime toggling.
